title: The Enneads, Vol. 2 (Psychic and Physical Treatises)
author: Plotinus
description: Stephen MacKenna’s translation of Plotinus’s second and third Enneads addresses nature, the cosmos, time, eternity and providence.
editionNote: 1921 edition. London: Medici Society / Philip Lee Warner. Edition credit: Stephen MacKenna (1872–1934).
